characteristics.harvestSeason: May–June (second harvest of the year, premium)

description.short: Premium, robust malty black tea with golden tips — the most celebrated and iconic harvest of Assam
description.overview: The second flush is considered the pinnacle of Assam tea: summer heat and humidity yield a more concentrated, full-bodied leaf rich with golden buds (tips), prized above all others.
description.leaf: Large, twisted, dark leaf with abundant golden tips ('tippy golden')
description.liquor: Very rich, dark red, almost mahogany liquor
description.aroma: Intense malty aroma with accents of honey and dried fruit
description.taste: Strong, full-bodied, malty, with subtle sweetness, pairs excellently with milk
description.processing: Plucking → withering → rolling (CTC or orthodox method) → full oxidation → drying

history.origin: The second flush is traditionally regarded as the prime season for Assam tea due to peak summer temperatures and the moisture of the monsoon season.
history.development: Assam second flush historically formed the foundation of classic British black tea blends, including traditional English Breakfast.
history.modern: Premium second flush lots with high tip content are marketed today as a distinct luxury category, fetching substantially higher prices than standard blending grades.
interestingFacts: The strength and bold character of Assam second flush made it the historic favorite for milk tea in British culture.
An abundance of golden tips is a visual hallmark of high quality by which tea tasters grade premium lots.
